integrity: The proof is symbolic. Its new step is the exact quotient of labeled cyclic decompositions by vertex relabeling: conjugacy classes of decomposition permutations are cycle types, hence partitions of the total stick count into component lengths. The bundled finite program is a regression check and is not used as evidence for the infinite claim.
scientific_limitations: The result is an upper-bound refinement only. It does not improve lower bounds for the number of link types and does not address labeled or oriented link variants. It inherits the source's uniform fixed-combinatorics semialgebraic chamber estimate.
title: Partition-quotiented chamber bound for polygonal links
